items.title: What Could Tesla (TSLA) Merger Talks Mean For Its Stock?
items.summary: Tesla (NasdaqGS:TSLA) and SpaceX are reportedly in advanced talks over a potential merger of their operations. The proposed deal would bring Tesla's automotive, AI, and robotics units under a shared structure with SpaceX's aerospace business. A combined group would consolidate Elon Musk's AI compute infrastructure, autonomous systems research, and launch capabilities into a single corporate entity. The reported Tesla and SpaceX merger talks are important, but investors should weigh them...
